import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    tokens = line.split()
    if not tokens:
        return
    s = tokens[0]

    result = 0
    left = 0
    n = len(s)

    while left < n:
        right = left + 1
        while right < n and s[right] == s[left]:
            right += 1
        if ((right - left) & 1) == 0:
            result += 1
        left = right

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
